test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

BRELF : CFGMS :: MJCLH : DIKMN :: EODET : ?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a1f1c2e0e287e69cf4678c429807103b753e0dd63cdb4c9fb12ff6a7e198b59.png] The logic followed here is: **1) Letters are arranged in ascending order (i.e. dictionary order).** **2) And then letters are increased by +1.** BRELF : CFGMS • **Letters are arranged in ascending order (i.e. dictionary order).** BRELF → Dictionary order → BEFLR. • **And then letters are increased by +1.**
